decision_statement: Adopt, for the valuation of portfolio 2026-11, the BTC price read through live_price at 10:51:44Z on 10 November 2026 (AER-1 receipt e9106453), a call made before this record was written.
context_at_decision: The valuation of portfolio 2026-11 needs a BTC spot price with a receipt of the read.
options_considered: Read the price through live_price, which issues an AER-1 receipt (chosen).
Use the last closing price of the market-data feed: no receipt of the read.
assumptions_depended_on: The price live_price returns is the upstream spot price it names.
success_criteria: One read of the BTC price, with its receipt cited by the record.

consent_posture.posture_class: no personal data: a public market price

affirmation_record.method: Ed25519 signature over the DPS person_approval assertion

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-EXAMPLE-VALUATION-1: the valuation agent drafted the proposal, I reviewed it as shown, approved the specification whose digest the attachment names, and I am the accountable owner of this decision. The call it adopts was made before I reviewed it.

re_decision_trigger: The valuation is re-run on another day.
